_comment: [Claude 2026-09-02] The pinned RL-ViGen tree, shipped as a job input instead of cloned at
run time. run_probe.sh cloned it from GitHub inside every billed job until 2026-09-02, when
two probes (bt1nlcstc5kg3qtqro52, bt1uk6ehfsfo6m49dsdn) died there with `could not read
Username for 'https://github.com'` after three retries -- while the same repository answered
git ls-remote from the laptop at that moment and returned exactly this commit. The container's
PRISTINE, deliberately: the runner applies P1-P18 to whatever it gets, and the vendored
working copy already has them applied (15 files modified under git status). Shipping the
working copy would patch a patched tree.
run_probe.sh verifies this sha256 before extracting. A silently swapped or truncated input
would otherwise surface minutes later as a patch anchor that does not match, with no hint why.
built_by: git clone https://github.com/gemcollector/RL-ViGen.git && git checkout <commit>, then tar czf excluding .git, __pycache__, .DS_Store, envs/DMCVGB, img, and the six robosuite robots Door does not use
known_divergence_from_the_commit: envs/DMCVGB is EXCLUDED -- 480 MB of mp4 distractor videos and colour tensors for the DeepMind Control variant of the benchmark. Nothing on the robosuite path reads them: wrappers/__init__.py is empty, train.py imports only wrappers.dmc and (lazily) wrappers.robo_wrapper, and the sole `from dmcvgb...` import is wrappers/loco_wrapper.py, which is not on this path -- and dmcvgb is not on the container's PYTHONPATH at all, so importing it would already fail. Excluded because a 667 MB upload was reset by peer mid-transfer; at 310 MB it is within the precedent set by the 455 MB places365 asset. THIS MAKES THE ARCHIVE UNUSABLE FOR THE DMC OR LOCOMOTION DOMAINS.

third_party/robosuite/robosuite/models/assets/robots/{sawyer,baxter,ur5e,iiwa,kinova3,jaco} are EXCLUDED -- 324 MB of meshes for robots this project never instantiates. Protocol.robot is 'Panda' and Panda's 84 MB of assets are kept in full. Safe by construction rather than by hope: robosuite reads a robot's XML in ManipulatorModel.__init__ via xml_path_completion('robots/<name>/robot.xml'), and register_robot only stores the class object, so importing robosuite never touches these files and only instantiating one of those six would. THIS MAKES THE ARCHIVE UNUSABLE FOR ANY TASK ON A NON-PANDA ROBOT.
img/ is excluded: README figures, 2 MB, read by nothing.

cfgs/task/TwoArmHandOver.yaml shows as modified in a fresh clone on macOS, because the repo ships both TwoArmHandover.yaml and TwoArmHandOver.yaml and a case-insensitive filesystem can hold only one. setup/apply_patches.py:177 already documents the collision. Neither file is on the Door path, so it changes nothing measured -- recorded because an archive that claims to be a commit should say where it is not.
